notes: Applies to baccalaureate students who enrolled in Summer 2023 or later; earlier entrants follow the archived requirements, which are not collected.

Breadth in Knowledge Domains and Exploration may not be met with courses in the student's own major department or cross-listed with it. Integrative Studies is exempt. The tree cannot express this; check it against the student's major.
Flexibility rules (substituting a 200-499 level course in a GenEd area, or 3 units of World Language at the 12th credit level for GWS/GQ) need adviser approval and are not modeled.
Additional University Requirements (US, IL, WAC, first-year engagement) may be met by courses that also count elsewhere, so their nodes are non-exclusive.

children.label: Writing/Speaking (GWS)
children.note: C or better required. Inter-Domain courses may not be used.

children.label: Quantification (GQ)
children.note: C or better required. Inter-Domain courses may not be used. 3-6 credits from mathematics, applied mathematics and statistics; at most 3 from computer science or symbolic logic (not modeled).

requirements.label: Integrative Studies (Inter-Domain)
requirements.note: Inter-Domain courses are each approved for two GenEd areas. Not subject to the own-major exclusion.

children.label: GA, GH, GN, GS or Inter-Domain
children.note: May include 3 credits of World Language beyond the degree requirement or the 12th credit level, whichever is higher (not modeled).

children.label: United States Cultures (US)
children.note: May also be met by an approved experiential learning program with adviser and dean's representative permission.

children.label: International Cultures (IL)
children.note: Approved Education Abroad programs may also satisfy IL.

children.label: First-Year Seminar (University Park)
children.note: First-Year Engagement is 0-3 credits and depends on the campus; University Park requires at least 1 credit of first-year seminar plus any home-college requirement.
